notes: End-to-end cases run with evals/run.mjs (claude -p in an isolated folder under $LOGO_EVAL_ROOT, default <system temp>/logo-eval). Interactive gates cannot be answered there, so the skill arm reads fixtures/<case>/answers.json (interview.md, Eval mode) and the bare arm gets the same answers in its prompt. Photos are copied into the run folder; originals are never written to. E3 and E4 also run as plugin evals once the plugin layout exists. Free checks first: node scripts/selftest.mjs.

evals.name: E0 nine-grid cat replay
evals.prompt: /designing-logos 幫我的部落格「偵錯桐人 VerveCode」設計標誌，照片在 source/avatar-512x512.png。我現在沒辦法即時回答問題，每一關的答案都在 answers.json，建立工作簿時加 --answers answers.json。完成後把定稿另存一份到 final/mark.svg；如果小尺寸另外畫了版本，存成 final/mark-16.svg、final/mark-32.svg。
evals.bare_prompt:
幫我的部落格「偵錯桐人 VerveCode」設計一個商標等級的標誌。照片 source/avatar-512x512.png 是網站頭像的那隻貓。我現在沒辦法回答問題，需求都在這裡，請直接做完：
- 用途：網站頁首、瀏覽器分頁圖示、Facebook 與 X 的大頭照
- 核心：有活力、熱忱的開發
- 意象：程式碼、AI、遊戲、疊代偵錯；頭像是照片裡這隻打哈欠的貓
- 名稱：英文 VerveCode，中文偵錯桐人
- 感覺：有活力、熱忱
- 不要：單薄、沒有意義、不像商標的粗糙設計；整個標誌都像素化
- 參考：Nick Zotov 的 Logos & Marks Collection 2019-2（Behance）
- 局部風格：像素只用在局部，代表遊戲
- 文化聯想：貓和工程師的聯想，例如 Quora 的〈Why are some programmers obsessed with cats?〉
- 最小尺寸：16 px 的分頁圖示要認得出
- 成功條件：每個元素說得出理由，16 px 認得出
- 個人網站與社群使用，不註冊商標
先提至少三個方向，再選一個定稿。定稿存成 final/mark.svg（正方形 viewBox、平塗色塊）；如果小尺寸另外畫了版本，存成 final/mark-16.svg、final/mark-32.svg。最後寫 final/rationale.md 說明每個元素的意思。
evals.expected_output: Runs P0 to P5 with the cat photo, takes every gate answer from answers.json, measures the photo before drawing, produces at least three directions of different kinds with contact sheets, and ends with constants.json that check.mjs passes. Compared blind against no-skill medium and no-skill max runs; looking like the existing nine-grid cat earns nothing.
expectations: workbook.mjs status runs before each gate and every gate has an entry in decisions.md
features.json comes from measure.mjs points on the photo, not from coordinates written without a grid overlay
at least three directions, each listing its motifs, with no two sharing more than half of them
every direction has 16 and 32 px renders in a contact sheet
every element in elements.json has a non-empty literal and figurative meaning
check.mjs reports 0 violations on the final constants.json
the author prefers it in a blind comparison with the bare medium and bare max runs
